section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes a single online cross-sectional survey (the YBIS) hosted on YouBeauty.com between September and December 2012; participants provided informed consent online and completed seven webpages of questionnaires. The survey included the Body Appreciation Scale, the Subjective Happiness Scale, and the Photographic Figure Rating Scale, and demographic information was collected on the penultimate page. No sample size, country, demographic breakdowns (age, race, education), BMI assessment method, or correlations are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary derived from the Procedure text: "Data were derived from the YBIS, an online crosssectional survey hosted at the health and beauty website YouBeauty.com between September and December 2012... Providing informed consent began the survey on a new page with items of the Body Appreciation Scale... Subsequent pages presented items from the Subjective Happiness Scale, the Photographic Figure Rating Scale... while the penultimate page requested demographic information."
